task: Rename all object labels in the document by appending '_renamed' to each.
macro:
import FreeCAD
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Box")
box.Label = "Box"
sphere = doc.addObject("Part::Sphere", "Sphere")
sphere.Label = "Sphere"
for obj in doc.Objects:
    obj.Label = obj.Label + "_renamed"
doc.recompute()
check: all('_renamed' in obj.Label for obj in doc.Objects)

task: Group two existing objects into an App::Part container.
macro:
import FreeCAD
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Box")
sphere = doc.addObject("Part::Sphere", "Sphere")
part = doc.addObject("App::Part", "MyPart")
part.addObject(box)
part.addObject(sphere)
doc.recompute()

task: Set an expression on a box's Length property to equal a sphere's Radius property.
macro:
import FreeCAD
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Box")
sphere = doc.addObject("Part::Sphere", "Sphere")
sphere.Radius = 10
box.setExpression('Length', 'Sphere.Radius')
doc.recompute()

task: Create a custom Part::FeaturePython object with a Proxy class that defines an execute method to set a shape.
macro:
import FreeCAD, Part
class MyProxy:
    def execute(self, obj):
        obj.Shape = Part.Box(10,10,10).toShape()
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
obj = doc.addObject("Part::FeaturePython", "CustomBox")
MyProxy(obj)
doc.recompute()

task: Measure the volume and bounding box dimensions of a Part::Box.
macro:
import FreeCAD, Part
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Box")
box.Length = 20
box.Width = 30
box.Height = 40
doc.recompute()
vol = box.Shape.Volume
bbox = box.Shape.BoundBox
doc.addObject("App::AnnotationLabel", "Result")
doc.Result.Label = f"Volume: {vol}, BBox: {bbox.XLength}x{bbox.YLength}x{bbox.ZLength}"
doc.recompute()

task: Mirror a box and create an array of two shapes combined into a Part::Compound.
macro:
import FreeCAD, Part
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Box")
box.Length = 10
box.Width = 10
box.Height = 10
doc.recompute()
mirror = doc.addObject("Part::Mirroring", "Mirror")
mirror.Source = box
mirror.Normal = (1,0,0)
mirror.Base = (5,0,0)
doc.recompute()
compound = doc.addObject("Part::Compound", "Compound")
compound.Links = [box, mirror]
doc.recompute()

task: Create a Part::Compound from three primitive shapes (box, sphere, cylinder).
macro:
import FreeCAD, Part
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Box")
sphere = doc.addObject("Part::Sphere", "Sphere")
cylinder = doc.addObject("Part::Cylinder", "Cylinder")
compound = doc.addObject("Part::Compound", "Compound")
compound.Links = [box, sphere, cylinder]
doc.recompute()
